findings.text: the gate log's revision line names 2721bdba (the base), while the run it records executed the changed tree -- it shows 107 passed including tests/test_newest_stream_is_read_everywhere.py, a file that does not exist at 2721bdba, and the sibling grep log at docs/figures/worker-death-is-recorded/newest-stream-grep.log:1 is stamped the same while printing RUN_STREAM_GLOBS, which that revision lacks; the manifest's after_suite.revision says c23c83ab, so the two disagree and a promotion reading the log cannot get the after-revision revision it stamps.

the new stream_paths_newest_first appends inside a loop over the include argument (PERF401), a finding the base revision did not carry; the repo's rule is that a commit adds no findings, and the same file is also among the files ruff format --check would reformat.
the new test file ends without a trailing newline (W292) and ruff format --check reports it would be reformatted, so the added test file carries a finding the base did not have.

_run_directory falls back to Path(str(record.get("log_path") or ".")).parent, which is the process working directory when a record carries neither run_id nor log_path; newest_stream then globs *.jsonl from the CWD, a behaviour the pre-change _run_stream_mtime did not have (an empty log_path read as no measurement) -- not observed reachable because live pointers carry both fields, but it is a new way for unrelated files to be read as a run's activity.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit-by-commit against 2721bdba; one new reader in recovery.py, two routing edits (the stall quiet-seconds and the classified row's stream age), the session lookup moved to the ordered reader, plus docs and a figure -- all inside scope.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when names tests/test_newest_stream_is_read_everywhere.py and a grep inventory; I re-ran that file at c23c83ab (8 passed) and re-ran the grep, which reproduces the claim exactly.
item_verdicts.goal: read the node goal ("one newest-stream reader the stall classifier and the session lookup both use") against the diff; reckon/crew/recovery.py:2082 defines the public newest_stream(run_dir) plus stream_paths_newest_first, and both consumers are routed through it.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it records commit c23c83ab, the changed paths, the exact gate command, base/after logs, the negative-control log and the six pre-existing failure ids, and leaves the driving followup open for the coordinator.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the manifest's six declared paths are reached by the commit's ten changed files with nothing outside them; git show --stat c23c83ab lists only recovery.py, resumption.py, the new test, the plan, the evidence anchor and the docs/figures/worker-death-is-recorded tree.

justifications.durability: the declared mutation (RUN_STREAM_GLOBS restricted to stream.jsonl) reddens 6 of the 8 added tests including test_a_stale_first_stream_with_a_fresh_resume_is_not_stalled, and the session assertion at tests/test_newest_stream_is_read_everywhere.py:188 compares resolve_session's answer against an independently derived observe_log result rather than a value the test passed in.
justifications.evidence: I independently re-ran the named test at c23c83ab (8 passed, review-gate.log) and confirmed the base/after failure ids are identical (6 failed/99 vs 6 failed/107), but the after gate log at docs/figures/worker-death-is-recorded/newest-stream-gate-after.log:1 stamps revision 2721bdba while it ran the changed tree.
justifications.fit: the reader follows the module's Mapping/Path idiom and introduces no banned plan or version label, but the commit adds two lint findings the base did not carry -- PERF401 at reckon/crew/recovery.py:2073 and W292 at tests/test_newest_stream_is_read_everywhere.py:193 -- against a repo whose binding rule is that a commit adds no findings.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/recovery.py:2082's newest_stream is the single reader, and the diff routes the stall quiet-seconds at recovery.py:3842 and the session lookup at resumption.py:424 through it, so the goal is met -- the only deduction is the CWD fallback at recovery.py:2112 noted below.
justifications.scope_discipline: git show --stat c23c83ab changes exactly the five files and the figures tree the manifest declares, with no path outside the fence and no plan-version or plan-modified meta line touched.
